create_batchnorm2d_reimpl: create a BatchNorm2dReimpl module with a given number of features for numerical stability testing
run_batchnorm2d_forward: run the forward pass of BatchNorm2dReimpl on a 4D input tensor to normalize it
reset_running_stats: reset the running mean and running variance of a BatchNorm2dReimpl module to zero and one
reset_parameters: reset all parameters of a BatchNorm2dReimpl module including weight, bias, and running stats
review_batchnorm2d_reimpl: review the BatchNorm2dReimpl class to understand its manual batch normalization implementation for stability testing
